### Seeing God’s Hand in the Shift from Rest to Responsibility
Author: Abby McDonald
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/seeing-gods-hand-in-the-shift-from-rest-to-responsibility.html
Passage: Genesis 2:15
Points:
- Work and responsibility were instituted before the Fall, demonstrating that labor is a good gift rather than a punishment.
- Taking care of what God entrusts to us deepens our gratitude and reflects His character.
- Ordinary and mundane duties bring glory to God when carried out with thankfulness to Him.
- Maintaining intentional moments of stillness and prayer helps believers recognize God's hand amid demanding schedules.

### The Breath of Life
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-breath-life
Passage: Genesis 2:7
Points:
- God formed man directly from the dust of the earth, highlighting the special dignity of human beings in creation.
- The breath of life from God endows mankind with a unique capacity to know and relate to Him.
- Genesis 2 focuses intimately on humanity's creation rather than chronological cosmos building.
- The use of the name Yahweh Elohim affirms that God is the sovereign Creator and Ruler of all peoples.

### Those Who Sleep in the Dust Will Awake
Author: Nancy Guthrie
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/from-dust-of-earth-to-breath-of-life/
Passage: Genesis 2:7
Points:
- God shaped human life from humble dust and imparted dignity by breathing His own breath into man.
- Physical bodies matter to God and are not discarded or unimportant in His sight.
- Even though human sin brought physical death and return to dust, Christ bore the curse to conquer the grave.
- Believers have a confident hope in the resurrection, when God will remake frail dust into glorious, imperishable bodies.
